info.title: SSBot
info.author: fungalspores
info.description: Send screenshots from Switch to Telegram
info.details:
Features

Browse all screenshots from emuMMC/RAW1/Nintendo/Album/ with a dark SDL2 GUI

Filter by game — L/R cycle through the games in your album, with real game names read from the console

Multi-select — mark several screenshots and send them as one Telegram album (up to 10 per message)

Send as photo or as file — photo shows inline in the chat, file keeps the original quality

Send to one or multiple Telegram chats (supports ALL option)

Optional caption via on-screen keyboard before sending

Fullscreen preview

Lazy thumbnail loading — only decodes visible images

Supports JPEG, PNG, BMP

Web Config — configure everything from any browser on the same WiFi (port 7777), protected by a PIN

Verified TLS to the Telegram API — the CA bundle ships inside the app, nothing to download

Catppuccin Mocha color palette

changelog:
What's new in v2.2

Filter by game — L/R cycle through the games in your album; real titles are read from the console's own album database

Multi-select — X marks screenshots and ZL clears them; the whole selection is sent as a single Telegram album, up to 10 per message

Send as photo or as file — toggle with ZR, in the web config, or with send_as in config.txt

Verified TLS — the Telegram server certificate is now checked; a CA bundle ships inside the app and is unpacked on first run

Web config is protected by a 6-digit PIN shown on the console screen, and no longer displays the saved bot token

Fixed: a config save split across TCP segments could parse as empty and silently wipe the stored config

Faster gallery — thumbnails are cached as textures instead of being rebuilt every frame

Screenshot list limit raised to 4096, and the app shows when it is reached
